hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) OUT=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); STATUS=$?; if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then MSG=$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | tail -20); jq -n --arg msg "$MSG" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Typecheck failed:\n" + $msg)}}'; fi ;; esac; }
